independent_checks: Untrusted source clone and context clone rejected; trusted contexts deeply frozen.
Sparse factors and packet_ids, cyclic values, unknown packets, more than two packets per factor, more than three factors and model-provided facts rejected.

Actual shi/ying participant role can supply focus. Unrelated primary role appearing only as a negative flag in strict source closure cannot supply focus; changed role cannot borrow primary participant identity.
Return relation from changed line can supply changed-role focus. Exact original source_ids retained; 19 expanded facts deduplicated, four rule premises distinguished from identity supplementation.
Synthetic hidden equality with no from/to still supplies hidden role and primary owner; this is offline fixture coverage only.
All compact message participant IDs resolve to role profiles; identity_facts duplication is omitted without deleting strict premises.
HTML markup remains text in data; new DOM preview uses textContent, validates before replacing container, and official test rejects executable image injection.

findings.reason: Profile packets preserve single primary/changed/hidden component identities and owning position/flags/motion without allowing the model to supply replacement facts.
Trusted strict premise closure checked before packet construction. Original rule source_ids remain exact; identity supplementation does not alter rule premises.

Coverage uses direct role selection or actual relation participants rather than all premise paths. Non-unclear direction additionally requires focus in selected major packets and compatible major effects.
Program does not derive a trend from packet/factor counts; mixed requires opposed selected major effects, and unclear can have no factors. These checks establish structural coherence only.
Preview uses textContent and a fragment replaced only after validation; no innerHTML sink accepts model text.

limitations: Free prose can still name unselected facts, misuse relation direction, invent unknown mechanisms or claim reality; packet membership alone does not assess those meanings.
A role profile contains a broader single-record background. Declared packet membership does not prove every fact is relevant or that a particular traditional choice is valid.

Repeated relation IDs are deduplicated in the distinct_relation_ids index and facts within each factor; the same record may appear in multiple factor panels. Neither deduplication nor factor effects prove interpretive independence or prevent rhetorical double counting.
This review is for an isolated trend development protocol and local preview, not P2/task-led/production admission, model semantic acceptance, expert confirmation or forecast validation.

findings: Read-only diff against audited task-led runner shows changes confined to packet-led context/validation/plan and fixed two-call accounting; UTC after-await and reserve/floor safeguards retained.
Plan/seal must equal independently rebuilt fixed Oct3 plan; tampered or resealed arbitrary plan, stale UTC date and prior execution/attempt rejected before credentials/network.
Only new authorized empty packet-led schema/campaign with exact 2 CNY cap is accepted; legacy campaign, existing reservation and unauthorized or changed cap rejected before credentials/network.
Wallet must cover full two-call reserve plus 1 CNY before reservation and again before second chat. Fresh UTC date checked after both awaited balance checks, and before chat.
At most two chats; first failed HTTP/SSE/schema/packet result stops without retry or settlement and retains full reservation. Second balance floor or rollover stops without another request.

Provider bytes independently archived before parse, strict usage/model/DONE and forbidden channels preserved. Response/check raw UTF8 and usage identities kept; network errors and bounded HTTP error body redact synthetic credential in tests.
Manual recipe hash identical across UTC and Asia/Singapore. Only trend packets injected; no old task-led advice mode or literature injection.
limitations: Mock success proves runner safety and archival mechanics, not model semantic quality or actual billing.
Price 2/8 is frozen plan metadata; this offline review does not independently browse or recertify current official price.
Reservation is deliberately retained on failure, and no automatic settlement is performed.
